scope: Historical single-passage diagnostics; configurations differ. Not full-repository or held-out ranking.

metric_notes.structural_acceptance: Existing deterministic checks passed / proposed candidates; not semantic accuracy, precision or recall.
metric_notes.median_success_seconds: Median among successful calls only; failures excluded, one call per passage.
metric_notes.measured_total_usd: Provider-reported charges across recorded attempts; null when charges unresolved. No invoice reconciliation or all-in enterprise cost.
metric_notes.context_tokens: Advertised model catalogue context, not actual input length or guaranteed endpoint setting.
